name: invideo
description: Connect invideo to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use invideo MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect invideo to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with aI video generation using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my invideo workspace.
Find anything in invideo that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review aI video generation in invideo.
